title: Lake Hopatcong Guide Service

services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: Summer 2026 will be our 5th consecutive summer hosting fishing camps for our area's youth anglers! These camps are near and dear to our hearts and have been an amazing experience for all involved. Our goal is to provide a safe, fun, and educational fishing experience to all who attend. We strongly push the importance of fishing buddies, on-the-water etiquette, and positive comradery among everyone onboard. In a nutshell, we want them to learn/become better anglers, have fun/grow their love for the sport, and make meaningful friendships/fishing buddies along the way! See below for details: SUMMARY: Each week of camp consists of 3 boat trips on Lake Hopatcong. Scheduled days to fish each week

blurb: Established in 2019, we are the largest and only full-time freshwater guide service in the region. Our professional guide-staff operates 7 days per week on the three premier fisheries in our region - Lake Hopatcong, Greenwood Lake, and the Delaware River. Our fly fishing guides are on the water daily and guide on all of the top trout streams in New Jersey. Our Musky team operates on numerous bodies of water all over
